name: submit_triage_verdict
description: Submit the structured triage verdict for a single Mercedes GLS candidate. Use this tool to return your decision. Do not produce a prose response in addition.

verdict.description: ACTION = worth contacting the dealer now. PASS = not worth pursuing. NEEDS_HUMAN = ambiguous or missing data, escalate to manual review.

reasoning.description: 2-4 sentences explaining the verdict. Lead with the decisive factor (e.g., 'PASS — 450 trim without the $15K-below-580 trigger met').

key_factors.description: Structured breakdown of the factors that drove the verdict. Use null for fields the email did not contain.

price.description: Listing price in USD, integer. Null if not extracted.

mileage.description: Odometer reading. Null if not in the email.

distance_miles.description: Approximate distance from 22180 (Vienna, VA). Null if dealer location can't be inferred from the listing URL.

deal_score_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the value calculation (e.g., '$2K under nearest 580 comp, CPO, Tier A').

action_items.description: Required when verdict is ACTION. 2-4 concrete next steps specific to this listing. Empty array for PASS / NEEDS_HUMAN.
